source_instruction: i am looking for travel foaming dispenser for hand soap. please choose rose gold and silver pump head.
query:
Oh my gosh, I have to tell you about the stray calico cat that showed up on my back porch this morning before I even had my first sip of coffee! She was curled up on the old wicker chair I keep out there, tucked right into the knit blanket I left draped over the arm last weekend, and when I cracked the door open to peek she just blinked slow at me like she’d been waiting for me to wake up. I ran in to grab a little dish of the tuna I keep for my own cat, and she trotted right over to rub against my ankle before she started eating, purring so loud I could hear it even over the neighbor’s lawnmower that was going two yards over. I stuck around to sit on the step with her for ten minutes, and she even climbed up into my lap for a minute, her little paws kneading my sweatpants like she was totally at home—now I’m low-key panicking a little because I don’t know if I should put up found posters or just let her move in permanently, honestly.
Hey, I’m looking through the refillable containers right now and need one that’s copper gold, can you help me track that down? I definitely don’t want to go over that one for the price, y’know the amount I always stick to for these little household buys? I saw a few with different dispenser tops earlier but I totally can’t put my finger on the exact style I was going for, none of the ones I’ve clicked on so far feel right. Can you pull up the options that match what I’m after so I don’t have to scroll through all two hundred listings?
